name: Indorenate
summary: Indorenate (developmental code name TR-3369), also known as β-methoxycarbonyl-5-methoxytryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B and 5-HT2C serotonin receptors.
